subject: PR #241 merged to main as 771dc91; the essay repo's duplicate bkmr index retired under a parity suite
result: Merged. PR EpiLogos/ai-kit#241 'knowledge: a tag is a property of a Source, not a curated node' squashed to main as 771dc91, branch deleted local and remote. Every check passed — including the 'Real bkmr 7.6.7 SourcePool conformance' job, which now exercises the same version this session installed on the machine. Main rebuilds and retests clean; product-ground back to the 7 pre-existing main-debt entries, none added. CLOSES the open items from tags-leave-the-wiki-node-namespace-2026-09-08 and bkmr-updated-to-767-vaultroot-ingest-2026-09-09: bkmr updated (item 4), link resolution settled (item 1), the work committed and merged (item 3), and the okf-workspace/.bkmr duplication ruled on (item 1 of the second return) — see O-I NOW: essay-repos-own-bkmr-index-retired-2026-09-09. The essay repo's own bkmr index is retired in favour of this ingest, under a standing 8-test parity suite that holds AIKit to the 884 canonical paths and six collections the retired index covered. AIKit's side needed no further change for that; the retirement is entirely in the essay repo. WHAT LANDED: tags leave the wiki:node:tag/* namespace and ride SourceBinding::tags; ingest reads records and source pages as two populations; links into a bibliography resolve as citations rather than dying; selection names rather than counts the files it cannot place; a tag:<value> query term narrows the SourcePool and a provider that cannot filter by tag is disclosed rather than silently answering the broader question; wiki ingest gains --source-pool and --room-depth; discovery identifies SourceMaterial structurally before the okf-wiki/v1 content sniff.
